name: shotos
description: SHOTos: an open way of working for people and AI agents. The core method plus optional packs.

plugins.name: shotos-core
plugins.description: The SHOTos core: six stages, four rules, twelve controls, 28 skills, nine role agents and a claim-check Stop hook that tests what agents say they did.

plugins.name: shotos-automations
plugins.description: Two free Google Apps Script automations with skills that set them up and run them safely: a signal engine that scores mail into one daily digest, and a batch document factory that fills a template from a sheet. Dry run, three-item pilot and read-back before any schedule.

plugins.name: shotos-content
plugins.description: Six skills for papers, slide decks, explainers, press releases, demo videos and creator edits. Every fact is sourced and nothing is published without a yes.

plugins.name: shotos-customer-success
plugins.description: Customer success skills for working with an agent: hand an account to the person who will deliver for it, and recover a stalled onboarding. Evidence first; messages are drafted, and sent only after a yes on exactly what goes.

plugins.name: shotos-exec-ops
plugins.description: Operating-week skills for founders and executives working with an agent: a pull-based daily brief, a leader's inbox, mail triage, meeting notes, weekly briefing, decision briefs and advisory sessions. Drafts by default; sends only after a yes on exactly what goes.

plugins.name: shotos-founder-admin
plugins.description: SHOTos pack for founder admin: grant and award finding, investor updates, due-diligence data rooms and advisory board setup. Drafts by default; submits, pays or shares only after a yes on exactly what goes.

plugins.name: shotos-media
plugins.description: Three skills for images, short videos and voiceovers: the agent looks at or listens back to what it made, clears rights and consent, and asks before anything is published.

plugins.name: shotos-records
plugins.description: Keep files findable and safe, for people and agents: a work folder, file naming, filing with de-duplication, and a quarantine for doubtful files.

plugins.name: shotos-setup
plugins.description: Run SHOTos itself: check which tools are connected, keep configuration as code with a drift check, right-size the effort for a task and audit a skill collection.

plugins.name: shotos-social
plugins.description: Social media skills for working with an agent, for any brand, club, creator or small business: set up an account, plan a week, write caption options, publish only through a frozen approval manifest, review engagement, share into groups and review monthly insights. Drafts first; a person approves.

plugins.name: shotos-trust
plugins.description: Checks before anything goes out: audit claims, check for public exposure, and check sensitive and children's data.

plugins.name: shotos-win-the-work
plugins.description: SHOTos pack for winning work: the LEAP pipeline, NUDGE qualification, relationship maps, contextual proposals, proposal factories, outbound prospecting and email replies. Drafts by default; sends only after a yes on exactly what goes.

plugins.name: shotos-writing
plugins.description: Three skills for writing people read easily: a plain-English check, an AI-tell check and translation that keeps names, numbers and meaning intact.
